subject: CAIQ runtime provenance: evidence crosswalk and 30-min mini-audit runbook
messages:
From: Jake Martin <security@calypsohealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ runtime mapping request + quick mini-audit

Hi Irene,

We're preparing a short CAIQ review focused on runtime controls for our integration with Redwood. The assessment team has a tight window and would like the following: a control crosswalk for runtime-relevant CAIQ/CCM items (multi-tenant isolation, KV cache handling, model routing/fallbacks, telemetry/observability, and key management), short narrative answers for those controls, and representative artifacts (sanitized logs / telemetry snippets, architecture diagram showing tenancy boundaries, and a sample runtime replay/trace).

Attached is our CAIQ scope template (CAIQ_Scope_Template.xlsx). Can your team produce a lightweight crosswalk and a mini-audit runbook we can use on Monday/Tuesday next week? Ideally a 30-minute call/demo where you walk an engineer through the runtime telemetry and show where proof artifacts live.

Two questions up front:
- Can you provide a redacted telemetry snippet and a short checklist for the mini-audit?
- Who will be the control owners for the runtime claims we rely on?

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Jake Martin
Security Programs 
Calypso Health
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jake Martin <security@calypsohealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime mapping request + quick mini-audit

Hi Jake — thanks for the clear ask and the scope template. We can definitely support a compact, evidence-focused session. Proposed plan: 

1) Deliverables by end of day Monday (2026-07-27):
   - CAIQ-runtime-crosswalk.xlsx (mapping CAIQ questions to Redwood runtime controls + short narratives)
   - A redacted telemetry bundle (telemetry-snippet.tar.gz) with a README explaining sample lines and redaction steps
   - Mini-audit checklist (mini-audit-checklist.pdf) + a 30-minute runbook for the call

2) Owners:
   - Runtime telemetry & logs: Priyom Das (priyom_das@redwood.com)
   - Key management & rotations: Kimberly Park (kimberly_park@redwood.com)
   - Overall security/compliance liaison: myself (irene_choi@redwood.com)

3) Suggested slot for the 30-min mini-audit demo: Mon 2026-07-27 or Tue 2026-07-28 at 10:00 PT. Please confirm availability and attendee list.

We will provide the crosswalk in the attached format you sent and include the specific CCM/CAIQ control ids per row. I'll ask Priyom to stitch the telemetry snippets and indicate exact locations in our observability portal where you can validate the traces during the call.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment notes: we will produce CAIQ-runtime-crosswalk.xlsx and telemetry-snippet.tar.gz, both with clear redaction metadata.
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jake Martin <security@calypsohealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime mapping request + quick mini-audit

Thanks — looping in the concrete artifacts we will attach and what you'll see on the call. Quick summary: 

Artifacts we will upload to the shared drive by EOD Monday:
- CAIQ-runtime-crosswalk.xlsx (sheet per control group: data protection, isolation, runtime integrity, telemetry)
- runtime-kv-cache-readme.md (explains redaction and sampling of KV cache evidence)
- runtime-telemetry-sample/ (contains runtime_kpis.csv, sample_trace.jsonl, and a short replay script placeholder)
- tenancy-boundary-diagram.png (annotated with routing tiers and tenant VLANs)

What we'll demo in 30 min:
- Where to find the sample_trace and how it maps to CAIQ control IDs (we'll show trace -> claim -> artifact).
- Tenant isolation proof path: auth->routing->keystore lookup (we'll show a redacted trace demonstrating the keystore call and tenant-id tagging).
- Key rotation excerpt and KMS audit entry (redacted).

Two logistics items:
1) Access: please provide one (or two) tester SSO accounts for the session so we can temporarily show traces in the observability console without exposing PII.
2) Mini-audit checklist: I prepared a compact checklist and attached it (mini-audit-checklist.pdf). It contains the evidence to request during an exploratory 30-min review (example GPO queries, trace searches, and confirmation prompts).

Kimberly — can you confirm that a short DocuSign/attestation note is acceptable if Calypso needs a formal owner attestation after the session?

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

— Priyom
SRE & Runtime Observability, Redwood Inference
From: Jake Martin <security@calypsohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ runtime mapping request + quick mini-audit

Irene / Priyom / Kimberly — all good, thanks. Confirming: Mon 2026-07-27 at 10:00 PT works for the Calypso team (we'll have two engineers and one risk manager). We'll share two SSO test accounts before EOD.

Requested pre-reads: the CAIQ_Scope_Template we sent, and your CAIQ-runtime-crosswalk.xlsx when available. We'll also accept the mini-audit checklist as the scope for the 30-min run.

One ask for the session: during the demo please highlight the specific CAIQ questions you’re answering (call out the row id in your crosswalk) so our auditor can tick the box live. Otherwise great — see you on Mon.

Jake Martin
Calypso Health Security Programs
